hints.title: Thue-Morse Shift Analogy
hints.text: Each doubling operation appends the string with every character shifted by 1. The character at index k - 1 is generated by shifting from 'a'.

hints.title: Binary Popcount Insight
hints.text: The i-th bit of k - 1 indicates whether the element was generated in the second half of the i-th doubling step, each contributing exactly 1 cyclic shift.

hints.title: Closed-Form Evaluation
hints.text: Count the number of 1s in the binary representation of k - 1 (popcount) and add this modulo 26 to character 'a'.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Counting set bits in integer k - 1 takes O(log k) operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building full string doubles memory exponentially.
